title: Return time
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D$, with vertex $t$ and step bound $N$. Define the return time at $t$ up to $N$ to be $1$ plus the average, starting from $t$, of the hitting time of $t$ up to $N$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph of degree D
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the meanings of the graph's average or bounded hitting-time functions.
